selection_rules: Preserve host responsiveness and storage safety margins before maximizing guest fidelity.
Never infer available capacity from total capacity.
Select only after fresh bounded readiness facts are reviewed.
Stop when the full-workstation minimum cannot be met safely; do not silently downgrade to a server or container image.
Record the chosen resources and supporting fact revisions in the future domain lock.

boot_profiles.purpose: Fast deterministic validation of system services and terminal-oriented procedures while retaining the complete Workstation installation.
Validate the Fedora Workstation desktop stack and virtual display/input/audio integration when a graphical session is relevant.

software_fidelity_targets: kernel release family when guest support permits
RPM and Flatpak package versions needed by a scenario
GNOME, GDM, Wayland, UPower, power-profiles-daemon and switcheroo-control
systemd units, SELinux policy class and boot configuration relevant to a scenario
filesystem and storage behavior supported by virtual devices
Bash and locally installed documentation matching observed versions
baseline_acceptance: Official supported Fedora Workstation artifact identity is locked and signature/checksum verification is complete.
The future domain, machine type, firmware, base image and installed package-set identities are digest-bound.
The guest reaches both declared boot profiles through separate disposable overlays.
Runtime network, sharing, clipboard, drag/drop, USB passthrough and GPU passthrough are absent.
The base is cleanly powered off and read-only before any scenario overlay is created.
Reset and evidence-export failures have been rehearsed without treating failure as success.
known_physical_limits: A normal VM cannot mirror the physical NVIDIA power state or GPU-to-panel wiring.
Virtual backlight and LED providers do not prove physical brightness or keyboard lighting.
ACPI, embedded-controller, firmware-hotkey, battery and thermal behavior require separately approved physical evidence.
Software success in the guest is not sufficient evidence that a hardware repair is safe or effective on the workstation.
stop_conditions: Host readiness is unknown, stale, contradictory or below the safe minimum.
The Fedora image, signed checksum, trusted key fingerprint or supported-release status is unresolved.
A requested feature requires passthrough, a host share, credentials or runtime networking.
Domain identity, baseline identity, overlay freshness or reset attestation fails.
Output is malformed, hostile, truncated, unbounded or contains an unexpected effect.
An operation would broaden from the exact approved gate or target.
